_comment: Q3 ladder leg G0b: byte-identity re-run of the stored 20-ep ARMED RAW arm (runs/cta_20ep_on).  Paths only.
Card Q3 (docs/SPEC_clock_temporal_anchor.md) G1 smoke ON arm — one knob
different from _golden63_20ep_cta_ctl.json (plus the anchor's own parameter
block, which is inert without it).
WHAT THIS ARM IS FOR (§4 G1): counters live, not cleanliness.  The gate is
* cta_folded_anchored > 0 — zero means the mechanism is INERT and every
downstream number is the legacy carry (standing invariant #4);
* the anchor is EARNED, not granted: every satellite starts LOOSE and
re-couples after clock_anchor_recouple_epochs, so the run-end line must
show both a LOOSE population early and cta_recouples ≈ #satellites;
* no new withholds, no solve failures, trips ≈ 0 on a quiet 20-epoch window;
* the ORDERING check that this card's placement exists for: post-fit σ̂₀
(code) and the within-epoch RAIM trip rate must NOT rise vs the control.
A stiff clock prior fights the per-epoch clock-ensemble common mode, whose
measured step is ~8.5 cm — well above this arm's √(q·Δt) = 3.0 cm — and
that conflict, if it is real, lands on the pivot satellite's rows and
shows up HERE first.  See SPEC §2.1's open note: the fix, if it fires, is
to fold the anchor gauge-free (rank-1 downdate of the clock prior's
information along the per-constellation common direction).
q = 3e-5 m²/s targets a √(q·Δt) = 3.0 cm walk at 30 s: decisively BELOW the
measured 9.23 cm (so the carry actually binds — the whole premise) and above
the ~2 cm physical floor, i.e. the middle rung of the pre-registered ladder.
The variance floor is (2 cm)² = the physical per-epoch change: the carry must
never claim to know the clock better than it can physically move.  At this q
the floor is armed but inactive (q·Δt = 9e-4 ≫ 4e-4) — the expected reading.
k = 6 and abs = 2.0 m are the DEFAULTS, carried here deliberately unvalidated:
§3 derives them from the measured |t| ladder of the clk census family, and
this arm is one of the runs that measures it.
FRESH lineage (the anchor is FINGERPRINTED); run alone.
